title: Sign in
description: Sign in to HuiTong with your work account.

landing.headline: Approved HR data, flowing between Singapore and China HQ.
landing.lead: HuiTong connects the OA platform, Singapore HR and HQ’s SAP, so one approval updates every system it should, without re-keying through Excel.

master.title: One employee master
master.body: Every field shows which system it came from, and conflicts wait for HR to decide.

automation.title: Approvals that trigger work
automation.body: An approved manpower request starts recruitment and onboarding on its own.

governance.title: Governed by design
governance.body: Role-based access, masked fields, an append-only audit trail and a cross-border transfer register.

teaser.title: The integration map
teaser.caption: Every connected system and the data moving between them. Explore it live after you sign in.
teaser.fallback: A central hub linking Singapore HR, China HQ SAP, OA approvals, Teams and DingTalk, with the Excel master being retired.

footer.challenge: SCCCI × NYP AI Innovation Challenge · Proof of concept
footer.data: All data is synthetic. No national ID numbers are stored.

form.heading: Sign in to HuiTong
form.invalidEmail: Enter a valid work email address.
form.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on where you left off.

demo.heading: Explore as a demo role
demo.description: Each role signs in as a seeded demo user and sees only what that role is allowed to see.

roleHint.HR_SG: Singapore employee master and payroll fields
roleHint.HR_HQ: China HQ records and conflict resolution
roleHint.AUDITOR: Read-only audit trail and access reviews
